measuredOn.what: The author-form standalone image from octabam f80ecfe, rebuilt on 5 October 2026.
measuredOn.carriesOverToTheSharedBuilder: The shared-builder image differs from it in 56 bytes (evidence/common-builder.json). None is a byte Sidechain Compressor places; none lies on the COMPRESSOR path the cycle matrix and static pricing run; six are stock DSP words for the cross-core mailbox and payload B's boot zero loop. The ColdFire unit that the formatter measurements ran is byte-identical. The measurements below therefore describe the module's own contribution in both images. They do not price other modules sharing a core.

sharedBuilder.notClaimed: No stress, audio render, ducking, cross-core timing or maximum-load run was made on a mixed image. Cycle bounds are not summed with other modules.
